title: Perdition
body:
Perdition features two new dimensions: Purgatory and Dis.

Cut a rift through reality or drink a strange concoction to find yourself in **Purgatory**, a desolate dimension with scattered unorthodox resources that however poses no threat to the player.

![A Purgatory Rift](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95bf603e9d3946dda4b6642230497eaaee9dfc6e.png)

_A rift to Purgatory_

![A scintillating archway in Purgatory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b3c5dcccc2f49ee2718e76a0f87e2db98c9f33e.png)

_A scintillating archway in Purgatory_

***

**Dis** is a barren wasteland most suited for mining, that is if the ores found in Dis didn't slowly infect and hurt the player over time. It is a dimension primarily suited for quarrying through the use of technological machines or magical rituals and shrines.

It can be accessed by making a traditional portal shape with elevated marble, made from quartz and diamonds, and lighting it with a Dis key.

![A view of the Dis sky from a cave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab2ee7013fa5221d0b969c084961e9309dd892ea.png)

_A view of the Dis sky from a cave_

***

Perdition requires [Lychee](https://modrinth.com/mod/lychee) as a dependency to add special types of recipes used to gather ingredients.

Perdition has integration with [Strange Matter](https://modrinth.com/mod/strange-matter), supporting anomaly generation and adding some alternate recipes using the resources found in Purgatory.

The loot tables of the ores in Dis can be edited to add custom or modded ores.

Feel free to use this mod in modpacks.
